notes: The breadboard image labels its upper half rows f-j; the catalogue names the upper half bank 't' (rows a-e). Holes were mapped by column strip, so only the column matters electrically.

Resistor spans columns 4 and 6, LED anode (bent, longer leg) in column 6, cathode in column 8, as read from the image. Orange wire goes to column 4; black wire goes to column 8 and then to the Uno GND pin next to AREF (GND.1).
Circuit: pin 9 -> 220 ohm resistor -> LED anode; LED cathode -> GND. The 220 ohm value comes from the manual's parts list and schematic.
